summary: JSON pretty printing is implemented in the rich repository, but nothing has been run: the tests were not executed, per your instructions, so all verification is by reading the code. Changes: JSONHighlighter in rich/highlighter.py; six json.* theme entries in rich/default_styles.py; the JSON renderable and a main-guarded CLI in new rich/json.py; Console.print_json in rich/console.py; package-level print_json in rich/__init__.py; new tests/test_json.py; a "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst; a new docs/source/reference/json.rst added to the reference toctree; and an Added entry in CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased. Nothing is committed. Two interpretation choices: "overflow none" is implemented as Python None, and the stdlib functions are imported as from json import dumps, loads to avoid shadowing the json parameter. The highest-risk item is the hand-derived ANSI expectation in test_console_print_json_styled; it is the test most likely to need correction once run.
